definition.name: align_audio_to_guide
definition.description: Align doubles (a second take, a harmony, a stack) to a guide item with stretch markers, the way VocalSync does: finds the hits (onsets) in the guide and in each double (sidecar), pairs them in order within maxShiftMs, and puts a stretch marker on each hit of the double so it lands on the guide's. Audio between hits is stretched; anchors at both ends keep each double's length. strength < 1 moves hits only part of the way. protectConsonants moves high-band hits (s, t, k, sh) as a block, so the stretch lands in the vowel after them instead of smearing the consonant. dryRun returns the planned moves and writes nothing. Each double's existing stretch markers are replaced; a guide that has stretch markers is refused (its hits would not sit where its source says). Returns, per double, the timing offset before and after (avg/max ms against the guide). Works on the items' source files (take FX are ignored). Requires the sidecar. Not pitch correction.

guide.description: The item to align to (the lead)

doubles.description: The items to move onto the guide

strength.description: 0..1, how far each hit moves toward the guide's

maxShiftMs.description: Hits further apart than this are not paired (and stay put)

protectConsonants.description: Move high-band hits as a block with a rigid tail of consonantMs

sensitivity.description: Hit detection: higher finds softer hits

minStrength.description: Ignore hits weaker than this (0..1 of the loudest)

definition.name: analyze_audio_file
definition.description: Analyze an audio file on disk (a reference track, a bounce, a stem) the same way as analyze_track_offline: integrated LUFS, LRA, true peak, crest, per-section loudness, band balance, resonance and sibilance hints, and an optional comparison against another file. Does not touch REAPER. Requires the Python sidecar.

path.description: Absolute path of the audio file

startTime.description: Start in seconds (default 0)

endTime.description: End in seconds (default: end of file)

sectionSeconds.description: Also report loudness per consecutive section of this length

referencePath.description: Absolute path of a reference audio file (WAV/FLAC/AIFF) to compare tonal balance and loudness against

referenceStartTime.description: Start of the reference excerpt in seconds (default 0)

referenceEndTime.description: End of the reference excerpt in seconds (default: end of file)

definition.name: analyze_fx
definition.description: Analyze an FX plugin and return a compact summary: FX name, preset, and notable (non-default) parameters. For EQ plugins, detects active bands with frequency/gain/Q/shape. For compressors, extracts threshold/ratio/attack/release/makeup. Use this before get_fx_parameters to understand what a plugin is doing without reading 500+ parameters.

fxIndex.description: Zero-based FX index in the chain

definition.name: analyze_loudness_curve
definition.description: Loudness over time of a track (or the master, -1) or an audio file: short-term (3 s) and momentary (400 ms) LUFS as curves (at most 240 points each, every point the loudest moment of its slice), integrated LUFS, true peak, LRA, PLR (true peak minus integrated), the loudest and quietest 3 s windows, and with targetLufs the spans whose short-term loudness goes over target + toleranceLu. Use it to see where a master gets too loud or a section drops away, before and after a change. Rendered once, no playback. Requires the Python sidecar.

trackIndex.description: Track to analyze, rendered post-FX (-1 = master: the whole mix). Give this or path

path.description: Absolute path of an audio file (WAV/FLAC/AIFF/MP3/OGG) instead of a track, e.g. a reference song

startTime.description: Start in seconds (default 0)

endTime.description: End in seconds (track default: startTime + 180; file default: its end)

targetLufs.description: Report the spans whose short-term loudness is above this (e.g. -14 for streaming)

toleranceLu.description: LU above targetLufs before a span counts (default 1)

definition.name: analyze_midi
definition.description: Analyze a MIDI item and return summary statistics computed in REAPER. Much more efficient than get_midi_notes for large items. Returns per-pitch stats (count, velocity min/max/avg/stddev), velocity histogram, and machine gun detection (consecutive identical velocities). Use this first to understand the MIDI data before reading individual notes.

definition.name: analyze_stereo_bands
definition.description: Stereo correlation per frequency band (low <120 Hz, lowMid 120-500 Hz, mid 0.5-2 kHz, high 2-8 kHz, air >8 kHz) of a track, the master (-1) or a stereo file: overall and worst correlation (+1 mono, 0 wide, below 0 cancels in mono), the share of time out of phase, side-to-mid level (dB, width), a short correlation series per band, and flags for a wide or out-of-phase low end or any band that cancels in mono. Rendered once, no playback. Requires the Python sidecar.

trackIndex.description: Track to analyze, rendered post-FX (-1 = master: the whole mix). Give this or path

path.description: Absolute path of an audio file (WAV/FLAC/AIFF/MP3/OGG) instead of a track, e.g. a reference song

startTime.description: Start in seconds (default 0)

endTime.description: End in seconds (track default: startTime + 180; file default: its end)

definition.name: analyze_track_aesthetics
definition.description: Analyze the perceptual aesthetic quality of a track's audio using Meta's Audiobox Aesthetics model (CC-BY 4.0). Bounces the track to a temp WAV file (post-FX, post-fader) and runs 4-axis perceptual quality scoring: Production Quality (PQ), Production Complexity (PC), Content Enjoyment (CE), Content Usefulness (CU). Returns scores 0-10. The clip is normalized to normalizeLufs (default -18 LUFS) before scoring, so level differences between versions do not bias the scores (CE rises with level; PQ barely moves). PQ (and partly CU) judge mix changes; PC and CE mostly follow the arrangement, so only compare the same time range. Measured noise: re-rendering the same 30 s clip moves PQ by ~0.05, a 10 s clip by ~0.4; treat smaller differences as no change. Requires the Python sidecar (run in a terminal: reaper-mcp setup-sidecar).

trackIndex.description: Zero-based track index (-1 = master: the whole mix)

startTime.description: Start time in seconds (default: 0 or use REAPER time selection)

endTime.description: End time in seconds (default: startTime + durationSeconds)

durationSeconds.description: Duration to analyze in seconds (default and max 30 — shorter clips are noisier). Ignored if endTime is provided.

normalizeLufs.description: Scale the clip to this integrated loudness before scoring (default -18 LUFS); false or null scores it as rendered

definition.name: analyze_track_offline
definition.description: Render a track (or the master, -1) once and analyze it offline — no playback needed, works on folder tracks. Returns integrated LUFS (BS.1770 gated), loudness range (LRA), true peak (dBTP), sample peak, crest factor, per-section loudness, band balance (sub..brilliance as share of energy), resonance hints (narrow peaks above the local spectrum) and sibilance hints (5-10 kHz spikes with times). With referencePath, also the loudness difference and tonal-balance difference (bands and third octaves, level offset removed) against that file. Use this for whole-song and mastering numbers (up to 900 s). Requires the Python sidecar.

trackIndex.description: Zero-based track index (-1 = master: the whole mix)

startTime.description: Start in seconds (default 0)

durationSeconds.description: Length in seconds when endTime is not given (default 30, max 900)

sectionSeconds.description: Also report loudness per consecutive section of this length (e.g. 10)

referencePath.description: Absolute path of a reference audio file (WAV/FLAC/AIFF) to compare tonal balance and loudness against

referenceStartTime.description: Start of the reference excerpt in seconds (default 0)

referenceEndTime.description: End of the reference excerpt in seconds (default: end of file)

definition.name: apply_fx_to_items
definition.description: Render in place: apply the track and take FX to items as a new active take (stereo, mono or multichannel). The old take stays, so the render can be switched back with set_active_take. Blocks REAPER while it renders. The item selection is put back.

definition.name: clear_envelope
definition.description: Delete ALL automation points from an envelope (or from one automation item's pool), resetting it to its default state

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track (from get_track_envelopes)

automationItemIndex.description: Work on the points inside this automation item (from list_automation_items) instead of the underlying envelope. Pooled instances share their points, so this edits every instance of the pool.

definition.name: comp_lanes
definition.description: Comp takes from fixed lanes: give time ranges and the lane to take each from ({ start, end, lane }, seconds, no overlaps); copies of those parts go onto a new lane ("Comp" by default) with crossfades where one range meets the next, and that lane plays alone. The source lanes stay untouched (silent), so another comp or set_track_lanes play can switch back. A range a lane has no audio for is refused with the gap; every refusal changes nothing. One undo point.

track.description: Track: 0-based index (-1 = master), exact name, "{GUID}", or "master". A digit string means a track name first, then the index.

name.description: Name of the new comp lane (default "Comp")

definition.name: copy_fx
definition.description: Copy one FX (with its settings) to another position in its chain or onto another track. Returns the chain(s) afterwards.

fxIndex.description: 0-based FX index in the track's chain

toTrackIndex.description: 0-based target track, -1 = master (default: the same track)

toIndex.description: 0-based position in the target chain (default: the end)

definition.name: copy_media_items
definition.description: Copy (duplicate or repeat) media items, keeping their spacing: by default right after the last one, or at `position` and/or on another track. `times` lays copies end to end (e.g. repeat a 4-bar loop 8 times). Copies get fresh GUIDs; MIDI copies get their own data unless `pooled`. One undo point; returns where each copy landed.

itemIndex.description: 0-based item index on the track (list_media_items order)

items.description: Items to copy

times.description: How many copies of the group (default 1)

position.description: Start of the first copy in seconds (default: end of the last source item)

trackIndex.description: Destination track (default: each item's own track)

pooled.description: MIDI copies share the source's data (edit one, edit all)

definition.name: copy_section
definition.description: Copy a section of the song (a region by list_regions index, or start/end) to another position: the items in it (trimmed to the section) and, by default, its automation (envelope points, plus a pooled copy of each automation item wholly inside the section; items crossing an edge are counted in automationItemsCrossing, not copied), on every track or the given tracks. With `insert`, time is opened at the position first, across the whole project like insert_time, so nothing there is overwritten (e.g. repeat a chorus). One undo point.

start.description: Section start in seconds (instead of regionIndex)

end.description: Section end in seconds (instead of regionIndex)

position.description: Where the copy starts, in seconds

insert.description: Insert time at the position first (default false: overwrite automation there, place items over)

envelopes.description: Copy the automation too: envelope points and the automation items inside the section (default true)

definition.name: create_midi_item
definition.description: Create an empty MIDI item on a track at a given time range (seconds). Use this before inserting notes.

startPosition.description: Start position in seconds from project start

endPosition.description: End position in seconds from project start

definition.name: create_track_envelope
definition.description: Create/show an automation envelope on a track. Use envelopeName for built-in envelopes (Volume, Pan, Mute, Width, Trim Volume), sendIndex + envelopeName (Volume, Pan, Mute) for a send's envelope (it appears on the track as "Send Volume" etc. and starts at the send's current value), or fxIndex+paramIndex for FX parameter envelopes. The envelope is made visible and active; an existing one is only shown (`created: false`). The track selection is left as it was.

envelopeName.description: Built-in envelope name: "Volume", "Pan", "Mute", "Width", "Trim Volume" (with sendIndex: "Volume", "Pan" or "Mute")

sendIndex.description: A send's envelope instead: 0-based send index (from get_track_routing); it starts at the send's current level

fxIndex.description: FX chain index (for FX parameter envelopes)

paramIndex.description: FX parameter index (required if fxIndex provided)

definition.name: create_transient_automation
definition.description: Detect the transients of a track (its own audio, before FX and pan) or audio file (same options as detect_transients) and write one pulse per hit onto an existing envelope of a target track — e.g. a lighting/DMX plugin parameter that should flash on every kick. Each pulse rises from baseValue to the hit level (peakValue, scaled by strength unless scaleByStrength is false) over attackMs, holds holdMs, and falls back over decayMs; a hit before the previous pulse has ended cuts it short. Values are raw envelope values (FX parameters 0..1, Pan -1..1). Create the envelope first with create_track_envelope (it returns envelopeIndex). By default the envelope's points in the range are replaced (replaceExisting). dryRun returns the points without writing. Use bands/minStrength/minGapMs to choose what the lights follow (e.g. bands ["low"], minStrength 0.6 for the kick accents). Requires the Python sidecar.

trackIndex.description: Track to analyze, rendered post-FX (-1 = master). Give this or path

path.description: Absolute path of an audio file (WAV/FLAC/AIFF/MP3/OGG) to analyze instead of a track. Read as-is: an item's stretch markers, play rate and start offset are NOT applied, so for a warped or stretched item use trackIndex (renders what REAPER plays)

filePosition.description: With path: project time (seconds) where the file starts, e.g. its item position (default 0), so times come back in project time

startTime.description: Start of the range in project seconds (default 0, or filePosition for a file)

endTime.description: End of the range in project seconds (track default: start + 60 s; file default: end of file)

band.description: Band to find hits in: full (all, default), low (<150 Hz: kick, bass), mid (150 Hz-4 kHz: snare, vocals, keys), high (>4 kHz: hats, cymbals)

sensitivity.description: 0..1 (default 0.5): higher finds softer hits, lower keeps only the big ones

minGapMs.description: Closest two hits may be, in ms (default 50); raise it (e.g. 250) for fewer, beat-level hits

minStrength.description: Drop hits weaker than this (0..1 relative to the loudest hits; e.g. 0.6 keeps the accents)

bands.description: Keep only hits whose dominant band is one of these (e.g. ["low"] for kick-driven flashes)

targetTrack.description: Track that holds the envelope to write (-1 = master)

scaleByStrength.description: Scale each pulse by the hit's strength (default true); false = every pulse reaches peakValue

attackMs.description: Rise time before each hit in ms (default 0 = instant)

holdMs.description: Time at the hit level in ms (default 30)

decayMs.description: Fall time back to baseValue in ms (default 200; 0 = cut off)

decayCurve.description: Shape of the fall: exponential (fast then slow, like a flash fading; default) or linear

replaceExisting.description: Delete the envelope's points in the range (plus the last pulse's tail) before writing (default true)

dryRun.description: Return the points without writing them

definition.name: delete_automation_item
definition.description: Delete one automation item. Its pool lives on while other instances use it. preservePoints keeps its points on the underlying envelope. Other selections are left as they were.

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track (from get_track_envelopes)

preservePoints.description: Keep the item's points on the underlying envelope

definition.name: delete_envelope_point
definition.description: Delete one automation point by its index (from get_envelope_points); returns the deleted point

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track (from get_track_envelopes)

automationItemIndex.description: Work on the points inside this automation item (from list_automation_items) instead of the underlying envelope. Pooled instances share their points, so this edits every instance of the pool.

definition.name: delete_marker
definition.description: Delete a project marker by its marker index number

definition.name: delete_media_item
definition.description: Delete a media item from a track

definition.name: delete_midi_cc
definition.description: Delete a CC event from a MIDI item by the ccIndex get_midi_cc returned. ccIndex counts every channel event (pitch bend, program change and pressure too), so CC indexes can skip numbers; only pass an index get_midi_cc listed

ccIndex.description: 0-based channel-event index to delete (ccIndex from get_midi_cc)

definition.name: delete_midi_note
definition.description: Delete a MIDI note by index from a MIDI item

definition.name: delete_region
definition.description: Delete a project region by its region index number

definition.name: delete_stretch_marker
definition.description: Delete a stretch marker by index from a media item

definition.name: delete_tempo_marker
definition.description: Delete a tempo marker by its get_tempo_map index. Returns the updated tempo map.

index.description: Tempo marker index from get_tempo_map

definition.name: delete_track
definition.description: Delete a track with its items, FX and routing (undoable with Ctrl+Z). The master track cannot be deleted. Later tracks move up one index.

track.description: Track: 0-based index (-1 = master), exact name, "{GUID}", or "master". A digit string means a track name first, then the index.

definition.name: detect_chords
definition.description: Detect the chords of a track, one media item or an audio file, one per bar (default) or beat: from MIDI notes (drums on channel 10 ignored; the lowest held note gives slash chords like C/E) or from audio (Python sidecar chroma; a track is read from its own items, before FX and pan). Track bars and beats follow the project tempo map; a file uses `bpm` (bar 1 at startTime) or fixed windows. Returns the key, the progression ("Am F C G"), and chord spans (equal neighbours merged): start/end seconds, bar.beat, chord, root, quality (maj, min, 7, maj7, m7, sus2, sus4, dim, aug; the model also dim7, m7b5, 6, m6, 9, maj9, m9, mMaj7, 5, 11, 13), roman numeral in the key, bassMidi (a MIDI note for a bass line, E1-D#2) and a 0..1 fit; "N" = no chord. Paginated (offset/limit). Audio uses the chord model (lv-chordia, slash chords and sevenths from a full mix) when installed (setup-sidecar --with-chords), else chroma templates; `engine` picks. Use it before writing a bass line or other parts to existing guitars, keys or vocals.

trackIndex.description: Track to analyze (-1 = master, audio only). Give this or path

path.description: Absolute path of an audio file to analyze instead (sidecar)

itemIndex.description: Only the time this media item covers on trackIndex (from list_media_items); instead of startTime/endTime. Audio renders the whole track over it

source.description: For a track: midi (its MIDI notes), audio (render it), auto (default: MIDI notes when it has any, else audio)

per.description: One chord per bar (default) or per beat

engine.description: Audio: model (the chord model, setup-sidecar --with-chords; also renders a MIDI track), template (chroma templates), auto (default: the model when installed). MIDI notes always use templates

startTime.description: Start of the range in seconds (project time for a track, file time for a file; default 0)

endTime.description: End of the range in seconds (default: where the track's last item ends, the project end on the master, the file's end; max 900 s for audio)

bpm.description: File only: its tempo, so segments are bars/beats from startTime

beatsPerBar.description: File only, with bpm: beats per bar (default 4)

windowSeconds.description: File only, without bpm: one chord per this many seconds (default 2)

limit.description: Most chord spans to return (default 64, max 256)

definition.name: detect_key
definition.description: Detect the musical key (e.g. "A minor") of a track or an audio file: from a track's MIDI notes (note time weighted by velocity, drums on channel 10 ignored) or, for audio, from its chroma (Python sidecar; a track is read from its own items, before FX and pan, without a render). Returns the key, confidence 0..1 (how far it stands out from the next candidate that is not its relative key, scaled down for a flat profile and by how well the key fits — its correlation), the relative key, the top 3 alternatives with their correlation, and the 12-bin chroma (C first). Use it before writing parts, choosing a pitch-correction scale or a harmonizer key.

trackIndex.description: Track to analyze (-1 = master). Give this or path

path.description: Absolute path of an audio file to analyze instead (sidecar)

itemIndex.description: Only the time this media item covers on trackIndex (from list_media_items); instead of startTime/endTime. Audio renders the whole track over it

source.description: For a track: midi (its MIDI notes), audio (render it), auto (default: MIDI notes when it has any, else audio)

startTime.description: Start of the range in seconds (project time for a track, file time for a file; default 0)

endTime.description: End of the range in seconds (track audio default: start + 60 s; MIDI and file default: the end)

definition.name: detect_transients
definition.description: Find the transients (hits/onsets) in a track (read from its own items, before track FX and pan, without a render; the master is rendered) or an audio file on disk: each hit's time in project seconds, strength (0..1, relative to the loudest hits), dominant band (low = kick/bass, mid = snare/vocals/keys, high = hats/cymbals) and peakDb, plus a tempo estimate, hit counts per band and, with sectionSeconds, how busy each part is. Hits are paginated (offset/limit). Use it to sync lighting, video cuts, markers or MIDI to a song; create_transient_automation writes the hits as envelope pulses directly. A file is read as-is (no stretch markers or play rate): for an item warped to the grid, pass its track instead. Requires the Python sidecar.

trackIndex.description: Track to analyze, rendered post-FX (-1 = master). Give this or path

path.description: Absolute path of an audio file (WAV/FLAC/AIFF/MP3/OGG) to analyze instead of a track. Read as-is: an item's stretch markers, play rate and start offset are NOT applied, so for a warped or stretched item use trackIndex (renders what REAPER plays)

filePosition.description: With path: project time (seconds) where the file starts, e.g. its item position (default 0), so times come back in project time

startTime.description: Start of the range in project seconds (default 0, or filePosition for a file)

endTime.description: End of the range in project seconds (track default: start + 60 s; file default: end of file)

band.description: Band to find hits in: full (all, default), low (<150 Hz: kick, bass), mid (150 Hz-4 kHz: snare, vocals, keys), high (>4 kHz: hats, cymbals)

sensitivity.description: 0..1 (default 0.5): higher finds softer hits, lower keeps only the big ones

minGapMs.description: Closest two hits may be, in ms (default 50); raise it (e.g. 250) for fewer, beat-level hits

minStrength.description: Drop hits weaker than this (0..1 relative to the loudest hits; e.g. 0.6 keeps the accents)

bands.description: Keep only hits whose dominant band is one of these (e.g. ["low"] for kick-driven flashes)

sectionSeconds.description: Also report hit count and mean strength per section of this length (e.g. 8)

limit.description: Most hits to return (default 200; 0 = summary only)

definition.name: disable_tool_category
definition.description: Signal that you are done using tools from a specific category. This is a semantic hint to help manage your context budget — the tools remain registered but you can use this to indicate you no longer need them in the current workflow.

definition.name: edit_envelope_points
definition.description: Edit existing automation points by index (from get_envelope_points): move them, change their level, shape or tension. Fields left out keep their value; all edits are validated before any is written. Give `db` on volume envelopes (Volume, Trim Volume, Send Volume): it is converted with the envelope's own scaling (fader-scaled volume envelopes store 716.2 for 0 dB, not 1.0). `value` is the raw envelope value (pan -1..1, mute 0/1, FX parameter 0..1).

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track (from get_track_envelopes)

automationItemIndex.description: Work on the points inside this automation item (from list_automation_items) instead of the underlying envelope. Pooled instances share their points, so this edits every instance of the pool.

points.description: JSON array: [{index, time?, value? | db?, shape?, tension?}, ...]

definition.name: edit_marker
definition.description: Rename, move or recolor an existing marker by its marker index number (from list_markers). Unspecified fields keep their values; name "" clears the name. Color is a native color int, stored with REAPER's 0x1000000 "custom color" flag. Unknown markers change nothing.

name.description: New name ("" clears it)

position.description: New position in seconds

color.description: Native color int (e.g. ColorToNative(r,g,b)); 0 keeps the current color

definition.name: edit_midi_note
definition.description: Edit an existing MIDI note by index. Only provided fields are changed. Positions/durations in beats from item start.

startPosition.description: New start position in beats from item start

definition.name: edit_midi_notes
definition.description: Batch edit multiple MIDI notes in a single call. Much more efficient than calling edit_midi_note repeatedly. Pass a native array of edit objects, each with noteIndex and any fields to change (pitch, velocity, startPosition, duration, channel). Only provided fields are changed.

startPosition.description: New start position in beats from item start

edits.description: Array of note edits to apply

definition.name: edit_region
definition.description: Rename, move/resize or recolor an existing region by its region index number (from list_regions). Unspecified fields keep their values; end must stay after start. Unknown regions change nothing.

name.description: New name ("" clears it)

color.description: Native color int; 0 keeps the current color

definition.name: edit_stretch_markers
definition.description: Edit existing stretch markers of an audio item in one call and one undo point: move a marker (position, seconds from the item start), change which source time it pins (sourcePosition) and its slope (-1..1, the curve of the stretch after it). Markers are named by index, in position order. position is in item seconds, as this tool and add_stretch_markers report them; get_stretch_markers lists raw take positions, which equal item seconds only at play rate 1 (divide by the play rate otherwise). Only the fields given change. Every edit is checked first: a marker moved out of order (position or source), onto another marker, outside the item, or a repeated index refuses the whole call and changes nothing.

definition.name: edit_tempo_marker
definition.description: Edit a tempo marker by its get_tempo_map index (only tempoMarkerCount > 0 maps have real markers). Unspecified fields keep their values. Returns the updated tempo map.

index.description: Tempo marker index from get_tempo_map

position.description: New position in seconds

timeSigDenominator.description: Time signature denominator: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 or 64 (give with numerator)

linear.description: Gradual (linear) tempo change to the next marker

definition.name: enable_tool_category
definition.description: Signal that you intend to use tools from a specific category. All tools are already registered and available — this call returns the full list of tools in the category so you know exactly which tool names to use. Use list_tool_categories first to see all available categories.

definition.name: freeze_tracks
definition.description: Freeze tracks: render them (pre-fader) to stereo, mono or multichannel and take their items and online FX out until unfrozen, to free CPU. Blocks REAPER while it renders (a few seconds per minute of audio). The track selection is put back. Not the master.

items.description: Track: 0-based index (-1 = master), exact name, "{GUID}", or "master". A digit string means a track name first, then the index.

definition.name: get_action
definition.description: Get one REAPER action: name, ids, toggle state, shortcuts, and its kind. For a Custom: macro, lists the steps it runs by name; for a script, its file path.

action.description: Command id (40001), named id ("_SWS_…", "_aee8…" — stable across sessions; prefer it for custom actions and scripts), or the exact action name

section.description: Action section (default main). MIDI editor actions need an open MIDI editor.

definition.name: get_builtin_knowledge
definition.description: Read one built-in (read-only) record by key: "plugins::<vendor>/<plugin>" (e.g. "plugins::fabfilter/pro-q-3") or "mixing-lessons::<slug>". Returns null when the built-in layer has no such record. The user's own "user::" record of the same name, if any, overrides it.

key.description: Built-in key, e.g. "plugins::fabfilter/pro-q-3"

definition.name: get_envelope_points
definition.description: Get automation points for a track envelope (or one automation item) with pagination. Returns time, raw value, shape, tension per point, plus `db` on volume envelopes.

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track (from get_track_envelopes)

automationItemIndex.description: Work on the points inside this automation item (from list_automation_items) instead of the underlying envelope. Pooled instances share their points, so this edits every instance of the pool.

definition.name: get_fx_param_modulation
definition.description: Read FX parameter modulation (REAPER 6.37+): LFO, audio control signal (sidechain follower) and parameter link, with the baseline. Without paramIndex, lists only the modulated parameters of the FX.

fxIndex.description: 0-based FX index in the track's chain

definition.name: get_fx_parameters
definition.description: List parameters of an FX plugin with current values and ranges. Supports filtering by name pattern, changed-only filter, and pagination. For a quick summary of active EQ bands or compressor settings, use analyze_fx instead.

fxIndex.description: Zero-based FX index in the chain

namePattern.description: Filter params by name (case-insensitive substring match, e.g. "Gain", "Band 1")

changedOnly.description: Only return params that appear non-default (value differs from minimum or formatted value suggests activity)

definition.name: get_fx_pins
definition.description: Read an FX's pin mappings: each input and output pin and the track channels (1-based) it connects to, plus the track's channel count. Pins 3/4 of a compressor are its sidechain input.

fxIndex.description: 0-based FX index in the track's chain

definition.name: get_fx_preset_list
definition.description: List all available presets for a specific FX plugin on a track. Reads names by loading each preset, then restores the FX state; a MIDI plugin (e.g. ReaControlMIDI) may send each preset's messages while listing. Lists over 256 (generic program slots) are not enumerated (truncated: true).

fxIndex.description: Zero-based FX index in the chain

definition.name: get_item_appearance
definition.description: Get a media item's color ("#RRGGBB" or "none") and fades: lengths (seconds), shapes (0-6) and curves (-1..1)

definition.name: get_media_item_properties
definition.description: Get detailed properties of a media item: position, length, volume, fades, play rate, take info, source file

definition.name: get_midi_cc
definition.description: Get CC (continuous controller) events from a MIDI item. Optionally filter by CC number (e.g. 1=modulation, 7=volume, 10=pan, 11=expression, 64=sustain).

definition.name: get_midi_item_properties
definition.description: Get detailed properties of a MIDI item including position, length, note count, CC count (CC messages only), channel-event counts by type, mute state, and loop setting

definition.name: get_midi_notes
definition.description: Get MIDI notes in a MIDI item. Supports pagination with offset/limit for large items. For a high-level overview of a large MIDI item, use analyze_midi instead. Returns pitch (0-127, 60=C4), velocity (0-127), position and duration in beats from item start.

limit.description: Max notes to return (default all). Use with offset to paginate large items.

definition.name: get_project_info
definition.description: Get current REAPER project info: name, track count, tempo, time signature, sample rate, transport state

definition.name: get_project_settings
definition.description: Get project settings: path, sample rate and whether it is forced, title, author, notes, repeat (loop playback), and metronome (a global REAPER option).

definition.name: get_record_setup
definition.description: Recording setup: the global record mode (normal, time_selection auto-punch, selected_items auto-punch) with the punch range, the record path, every armed track (or every track with all) with its input ("In 3/4", "MIDI: all inputs"), monitoring, record mode and input FX count, and the audio and MIDI inputs that exist. Read this before arming or recording.

all.description: List every track, not only the armed ones (max 64)

definition.name: get_render_settings
definition.description: Get the project render settings: output directory, file name pattern, format with its bit depth or MP3 bitrate, secondary format, source (master, stems, selected items, region matrix with its rows), bounds (custom/project/time_selection/…), custom start/end, sample rate (0 = project rate), channels, dither and noise shaping, loudness normalization and limiter, embedded metadata, and the target files a render would write.

definition.name: get_selected_items
definition.description: Get the media items selected right now, as {trackIndex, itemIndex} (the indexes list_media_items and the item tools use) with the track name, position and length in seconds, and mute. Use it when the user says "the selected items", instead of guessing which tracks they mean. Paged: returns {total, hasMore, items}; pass offset to read on.

definition.name: get_selected_tracks
definition.description: Get all currently selected tracks in REAPER with their indices and names; a selected master track is listed first as index -1

definition.name: get_stretch_markers
definition.description: List all stretch markers in a media item with their positions and source positions

definition.name: get_take_fx
definition.description: List the FX on a take (its own FX chain, separate from the track FX). With fxIndex, also lists that FX's parameters with values and formatted text (paginate large plugins with offset/limit; the result has paramTotal and hasMore).

fxIndex.description: 0-based take FX index whose parameters to list

definition.name: get_tempo_map
definition.description: Get all tempo and time signature change points in the project (tempo map markers)

definition.name: get_time_selection
definition.description: Get the current time selection (loop selection) start and end in seconds

definition.name: get_track_envelopes
definition.description: List all automation envelopes on a track (volume, pan, mute, FX params, sends, etc.) with point and automation item counts. Send envelopes (all named "Send Volume", "Send Pan", ...) carry `send`: the send index and destination track.

definition.name: get_track_lanes
definition.description: A track's fixed lanes (REAPER 7): whether they are on, each lane's name, whether it plays (exclusive, layered or off) and its items (index, position, length, take name; 100 per lane, then itemsMore). Use before comp_lanes to see which take is on which lane.

track.description: Track: 0-based index (-1 = master), exact name, "{GUID}", or "master". A digit string means a track name first, then the index.

definition.name: get_track_properties
definition.description: Get detailed properties of a specific track including volume, pan, mute, solo, and FX chain

definition.name: get_track_routing
definition.description: Get sends, receives, and parent/folder information for a track — useful for understanding bus structure

definition.name: get_transport_state
definition.description: Get current transport state: play/record/pause status, cursor positions, tempo, time signature

definition.name: import_midi_file
definition.description: Import a Standard MIDI File (.mid/.midi, type 0 or 1, up to 5 MB and 20000 notes) as MIDI items, without REAPER's import dialog: notes and controllers of every file track merged into one item on trackIndex, or with newTracks each file track on a new track named after it, inserted at trackIndex. Placed at position (seconds) on the project grid; the file's tempo is reported, not applied (set it with set_project_tempo). Pitch bend, program changes, aftertouch and sysex are not imported; file.notImported counts them. One undo point.

path.description: Absolute path of the .mid/.midi file

trackIndex.description: Track to put the item on, or with newTracks where the new tracks are inserted

newTracks.description: One new named track per file track (default: merge onto trackIndex)

position.description: Project time in seconds where the file starts (default 0)

definition.name: insert_audio_file
definition.description: Insert an audio file (WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP3, …) onto a track as a new item at a position. The item is as long as the file. Refused, with nothing changed, when the file does not exist or REAPER cannot read it as audio.

filePath.description: Absolute path of the audio file

position.description: Item start in seconds (default: the edit cursor)

definition.name: insert_automation_item
definition.description: Insert an automation item on an envelope. Without poolId it starts a new pool, filled from `points` (times in seconds from the item start); with the poolId of an existing item (on any track) it adds a pooled instance with the same points, so editing one edits all; pooledWith counts the other instances in the project (use this for repeated sections such as every chorus). captureEnvelope moves the underlying envelope points in the range into the new item instead. Automation items override the underlying envelope where they sit.

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track (from get_track_envelopes)

position.description: Item start in seconds

points.description: New pool only. JSON array [{time, value | db, shape?, tension?}], time from the item start. Give `db` on volume envelopes (Volume, Trim Volume, Send Volume): it is converted with the envelope's own scaling (fader-scaled volume envelopes store 716.2 for 0 dB, not 1.0). `value` is the raw envelope value (pan -1..1, mute 0/1, FX parameter 0..1).

captureEnvelope.description: Move the underlying points in range into the item (new pool)

startOffset.description: Seconds into the pool's points where this instance starts

loop.description: Loop the pool's points when the item is longer than them

name.description: Pool name, shared by every instance (e.g. "Vox Chorus")

definition.name: insert_envelope_point
definition.description: Insert an automation point on a track envelope (or inside an automation item) at a time in seconds. Give `db` on volume envelopes (Volume, Trim Volume, Send Volume): it is converted with the envelope's own scaling (fader-scaled volume envelopes store 716.2 for 0 dB, not 1.0). `value` is the raw envelope value (pan -1..1, mute 0/1, FX parameter 0..1).

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track (from get_track_envelopes)

automationItemIndex.description: Work on the points inside this automation item (from list_automation_items) instead of the underlying envelope. Pooled instances share their points, so this edits every instance of the pool.

db.description: Level in dB (volume envelopes only), instead of value

definition.name: insert_envelope_points
definition.description: Batch insert automation points on a track envelope (or inside an automation item). Much faster than repeated insert_envelope_point calls. Give `db` on volume envelopes (Volume, Trim Volume, Send Volume): it is converted with the envelope's own scaling (fader-scaled volume envelopes store 716.2 for 0 dB, not 1.0). `value` is the raw envelope value (pan -1..1, mute 0/1, FX parameter 0..1).

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track (from get_track_envelopes)

automationItemIndex.description: Work on the points inside this automation item (from list_automation_items) instead of the underlying envelope. Pooled instances share their points, so this edits every instance of the pool.

points.description: JSON array of point objects: [{time, value | db, shape?, tension?}, ...]

definition.name: insert_midi_cc
definition.description: Insert a CC (continuous controller) event. Common CC numbers: 1=modulation, 7=volume, 10=pan, 11=expression, 64=sustain, 74=filter cutoff.

position.description: Position in beats from item start

definition.name: insert_midi_note
definition.description: Insert a single MIDI note. Pitch: 0-127 (60=C4/Middle C, 48=C3, 72=C5). Velocity: 1-127 (64=medium, 100=strong, 127=max). Position/duration in beats from item start (1.0=quarter, 0.5=eighth, 0.25=sixteenth).

startPosition.description: Start position in beats from item start

definition.name: insert_midi_notes
definition.description: Batch insert multiple MIDI notes in a single call. Pass a native array of note objects. Each note: { pitch, velocity, startPosition, duration, channel? }. Positions/durations in beats from item start (1.0=quarter, 0.5=eighth).

startPosition.description: Start position in beats from item start

definition.name: insert_time
definition.description: Open empty time at a position across the whole project: every item, marker, region, tempo marker, envelope point and automation item at or after it moves later by `length`; items spanning it are split (unless splitItems: false) and regions spanning it grow. An automation item spanning the position stays where it is (counted in automationItemsSpanning). Independent of REAPER's ripple settings. One undo point; returns what moved.

position.description: Where to open time, in seconds

length.description: How much time to insert, in seconds

splitItems.description: Split items that span the position (default true)

definition.name: insert_track_template
definition.description: Insert the track(s) from an .RTrackTemplate at a position, each with fresh identities. See list_track_templates for names.

name.description: Name under TrackTemplates/, or an absolute path to a .RTrackTemplate file

index.description: 0-based position of the first inserted track (default: the end)

definition.name: list_automation_items
definition.description: List the automation items on an envelope: index, poolId, pool name, position, length, loop, baseline/amplitude and point count. Items with the same poolId share their points.

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track (from get_track_envelopes)

definition.name: list_available_fx
definition.description: Enumerate all installed FX plugins in REAPER (VST, VST3, JS, CLAP, AU) with an optional category filter

definition.name: list_builtin_knowledge
definition.description: List the built-in (read-only, curated) mix knowledge: plugin records and mixing lessons. Without query: summaries (key, tags, preview) — filter plugins by tags such as "category::eq" or "fx::Pro-Q 3". With query: full-text search returning full bodies. Combine with the user's own LoreKit layer (user:: keys), which overrides these.

tags.description: List mode: return rows having ANY of these tags (e.g. ["category::compressor"])

query.description: Full-text search instead of a list (e.g. "drum bus attack")

limit.description: Max results (default 50 for list, 5 for search)

definition.name: list_fx_chains
definition.description: List the .RfxChain files in REAPER's FXChains folder (and subfolders), by the name load_fx_chain takes

definition.name: list_markers
definition.description: List all project markers with index, name, position, and color

definition.name: list_media_items
definition.description: List all media items on a track with position, length, name, volume, mute state, and whether it is MIDI or audio

definition.name: list_midi_items
definition.description: List all MIDI items on a track with position, length, and note/CC counts. ccCount counts CC messages only; channelEventCount and channelEventCounts include pitch bend, program change and pressure events

definition.name: list_monitoring_fx
definition.description: List the monitoring FX chain (on the master, heard only in your monitors, never rendered — room correction, a reference meter, a mono check). Global to REAPER, not saved in the project.

definition.name: list_regions
definition.description: List all project regions with index, name, start/end positions, and color

definition.name: list_takes
definition.description: List the takes of a media item: name, which one is active, MIDI or audio, source file, and take FX count

definition.name: list_tool_categories
definition.description: List all available tool categories with descriptions and tool names. Use this to discover what tools are available without loading every tool schema. Categories: project, tracks, fx, transport, midi, media, arrange, selection, recording, markers, tempo, envelopes, analysis, discovery, snapshots, routing, plan, actions, takes, fx_files, knowledge, plugin_authoring.

definition.name: list_track_templates
definition.description: List the .RTrackTemplate files in REAPER's TrackTemplates folder (and subfolders), by the name insert_track_template takes

definition.name: list_tracks
definition.description: List tracks in the current REAPER project with name, index, volume, mute/solo state, and folder structure. In large sessions filter it: parent (a folder track — returns everything inside it), nameContains, compact (index, name, parentIndex, depth, volume, pan, mute, solo, fxCount only), offset/limit. With no params it returns every track as before; with any, it returns { total, offset, returned, hasMore, tracks }.

parent.description: Folder track (index or exact name) — return only the tracks inside it, at any depth

nameContains.description: Only tracks whose name contains this (case-insensitive)

compact.description: Only index, name, parentIndex, depth, volume, pan, mute, solo, fxCount

limit.description: Return at most this many tracks

definition.name: load_fx_chain
definition.description: Load an .RfxChain file onto a track: appended after its FX (default) or replacing them. Each loaded FX gets a fresh identity. See list_fx_chains for names.

name.description: Name under FXChains/ (e.g. "Vocals/Lead"), or an absolute path to a .RfxChain file

mode.description: append (default) or replace the track's FX

definition.name: measure_masking
definition.description: Find where 2-8 tracks compete for the same frequencies: renders each track over the same range (post-FX) and compares their K-weighted third-octave levels (40 Hz-16 kHz). A band scores high when both tracks are loud there and within a few dB of each other. Returns every pair's overall score with its worst bands, and the top conflicts (score >= 0.2) with a suggestion: which track to cut around which frequency (the one the band matters less to). Pick a section where they all play (max 60 s). Requires the Python sidecar.

tracks.description: Zero-based indexes of 2-8 tracks to compare (e.g. kick, bass, keys)

startTime.description: Start of the range in seconds

definition.name: measure_track_alignment
definition.description: Measure the time offset and polarity of one track against a reference track (e.g. snare bottom vs snare top, kick sub vs kick in, overheads vs snare) by rendering both over the same range and cross-correlating them. A positive delayMs means the track arrives later than the reference, as both play now (the current playback offset and polarity are included). To align it, set_track_property playOffsetMs = suggestedPlayOffsetMs and phase = suggestedPhase (1 = inverted) on that track — absolute values that already account for the current settings, so re-measuring an aligned track suggests what it already has. Renders are post-FX (plugin latency is compensated). Pick a range where both tracks play the same hits; below correlation 0.3 no suggestion is made. Requires the Python sidecar.

referenceTrack.description: Zero-based index of the reference track

trackIndex.description: Zero-based index of the track to measure

startTime.description: Start of the range in seconds

maxLagMs.description: Largest offset to search either way in ms (default 20; room mics may need 30-50)

definition.name: measure_tracks
definition.description: Play audio and collect analysis measurements (LUFS, crest factor, correlation, spectrum) for one or more tracks in a single call. Handles playback start/stop automatically. LUFS and spectrum (1/3-octave bands) support multi-track; crest/correlation use global gmem and are only reliable for single-track measurement. First call may be slower due to JSFX meter auto-insertion. Readings are pre-fader (meters sit in each track FX chain): add each track volume to compare tracks; a folder/bus reads its children post-fader. Use this to balance tracks in LU and compare spectra on `kDb`. Afterwards it removes the MCP meters on the measured tracks (also ones an earlier call left) unless keepMeters. A meter that received no audio (muted, frozen or silent track, nothing in range) is reported under errors, not as numbers. For whole-song, folder or master numbers without playback, prefer analyze_track_offline.

trackIndices.description: Track indices to measure (max 8; -1 = master track)

durationSeconds.description: How long to play for measurement (seconds)

startPosition.description: Project position to seek to before playing (seconds)

targetLufs.description: The integrated loudness you are working to, in LUFS, from the task (e.g. -14 for streaming, -23 for EBU R128 broadcast). Optional; shown against the reading on the bridge page, never changes the measurement

keepMeters.description: Leave the MCP meter JSFX on the tracks (default: remove them afterwards)

definition.name: move_fx
definition.description: Move one FX to another position in its chain, or to another track (with its settings). Returns the chain(s) afterwards.

fxIndex.description: 0-based FX index in the track's chain

toTrackIndex.description: 0-based target track, -1 = master (default: the same track)

toIndex.description: 0-based position in the target chain (default: the end)

definition.name: move_media_item
definition.description: Move a media item to a new position and/or a different track

definition.name: move_track
definition.description: Move a track to a new 0-based position; the other tracks shift around it. The user's track selection is kept.

track.description: Track: 0-based index (-1 = master), exact name, "{GUID}", or "master". A digit string means a track name first, then the index.

toIndex.description: 0-based position the track ends up at

definition.name: play
definition.description: Start playback in REAPER

definition.name: process_items
definition.description: Process audio items: `normalize` sets item gain so each item hits `target` dB (mode peak by default, or true_peak, lufs_i, rms, lufs_m_max, lufs_s_max; non-peak modes need a target), measured over what the item plays; `reverse` toggles each active take's direction (a take already reversed plays forward again); `glue` joins the whole items on each track into one new item, whatever the time selection. MIDI items are refused for normalize/reverse. The selection is kept. One undo point; normalize returns each item's level and gain before and after.

itemIndex.description: 0-based item index on the track (list_media_items order)

items.description: Items to process

mode.description: Normalize measurement (default peak)

target.description: Normalize target in dB (default 0 for peak modes)

definition.name: quantize_audio
definition.description: Quantize an audio item to the grid with stretch markers: finds the hits in the item's source (sidecar), puts a marker on each and moves it toward the nearest grid line (strength, window and swing as quantize_midi). The item keeps its length (anchors at both ends); the item's existing stretch markers are replaced. Returns the timing offset before and after (avg/max ms). Requires the sidecar.

strength.description: 0..1, how far each hit moves toward its line

window.description: 0..1 of half a grid step (times 1 + swing, as quantize_midi); hits further from a line stay put

sensitivity.description: Hit detection: higher finds softer hits

minStrength.description: Ignore hits weaker than this (0..1 of the loudest)

definition.name: quantize_midi
definition.description: Quantize the notes of a MIDI item to the project grid (beats, not the item start): grid in beats (1 = quarter, 0.5 = 8th, 0.25 = 16th, 1/3 = 8th triplet), strength 0..1 (partial moves keep feel), swing 0..0.9 (pushes every second grid line later), window 0..1 (only notes within that fraction of half the gap to the next line move; with swing the gaps are uneven, so the reach is (1 + swing) times half a step), lengths "keep" (default, notes move whole) or "quantize" (ends snap too). Acts on all notes or a selection (indexes, pitch range, channel). One undo point; a refused call changes nothing. Returns how many notes moved and the average and largest shift in beats.

itemIndex.description: MIDI item index on the track (0-based, from list_midi_items)

notes.description: Only these note indexes (from get_midi_notes); default: every note matching pitchMin/pitchMax/channel

pitchMin.description: Only notes at or above this pitch

pitchMax.description: Only notes at or below this pitch

channel.description: Only notes on this MIDI channel (0-15; 9 = GM drums)

strength.description: How far notes move toward the grid, 0..1 (default 1)

swing.description: Off-beat delay as a fraction of a grid step, 0..0.9 (default 0)

window.description: Only move notes within this fraction of half the gap between lines, (1 + swing) half steps with swing (default 1 = all)

lengths.description: keep (default): notes keep their length; quantize: note ends snap too

definition.name: read_track_correlation
definition.description: Read stereo field correlation and M/S analysis for a track. Auto-inserts the MCP Correlation Meter JSFX if not present. Returns correlation coefficient (-1 to +1), stereo width, and mid/side levels. Audio must be playing to accumulate data.

definition.name: read_track_crest
definition.description: Read crest factor (peak-to-RMS ratio) for a track. Auto-inserts the MCP Crest Factor Meter JSFX if not present. Returns crest factor in dB (higher = more dynamic, lower = over-compressed), peak hold level, and RMS level. Audio must be playing to accumulate data.

definition.name: read_track_lufs
definition.description: Read ITU-R BS.1770 loudness data for a track. Auto-inserts the MCP LUFS Meter JSFX if not present. Returns integrated, short-term (3s), and momentary (400ms) LUFS plus true inter-sample peak levels. Audio must be playing to accumulate data. The meter sits in the track FX chain, so it reads pre-fader: add the track volume (dB) for its level in the mix. Compare tracks in LU against the mix bus over the same section.

targetLufs.description: The integrated loudness you are working to, in LUFS, from the task (e.g. -14 for streaming, -23 for EBU R128 broadcast). Optional; shown against the reading on the bridge page, never changes the measurement

definition.name: read_track_meters
definition.description: Read real-time peak and RMS levels (in dB) for a track. Returns L/R peak and RMS values.

definition.name: read_track_spectrum
definition.description: Read the real-time frequency spectrum of a track while audio plays. Auto-inserts the MCP Spectrum Analyzer JSFX if not present. Returns 1/3-octave bands (25 Hz-16 kHz, ~0.5 s smoothed), each with raw `db` and K-weighted `kDb` (the BS.1770 weighting LUFS uses). Judge on `kDb`, never `db` (raw levels overstate the lows and understate 2-5 kHz), and compare a band only with the same band on another track or a reference. Pre-fader (the analyzer sits in the track FX chain); each read is a ~0.5 s snapshot, so read several times. Raw FFT bins only with includeBins.

includeBins.description: Also return every raw FFT bin (large: fftSize/2 values)

definition.name: record
definition.description: Start recording in REAPER. Refused when no track is armed (REAPER would open a dialog that blocks the bridge): arm the target tracks first with set_track_record

definition.name: redo_project
definition.description: Redo the last undone edit in the REAPER project and report its label, plus the next undo/redo labels.

definition.name: remove_envelope_points
definition.description: Delete automation points in a time range from a track envelope (or automation item). Use to surgically remove a section of automation.

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track (from get_track_envelopes)

automationItemIndex.description: Work on the points inside this automation item (from list_automation_items) instead of the underlying envelope. Pooled instances share their points, so this edits every instance of the pool.

timeStart.description: Start of time range in seconds (inclusive)

timeEnd.description: End of time range in seconds (exclusive)

definition.name: remove_fx
definition.description: Remove an FX plugin from a track by its index in the FX chain

fxIndex.description: Zero-based FX index in the chain

definition.name: remove_monitoring_fx
definition.description: Remove a monitoring FX by index (from list_monitoring_fx).

definition.name: remove_send
definition.description: Remove a send, receive or hardware output by its index. Removing a receive removes the other track's send.

track.description: Track: 0-based index (-1 = master), exact name, "{GUID}", or "master". A digit string means a track name first, then the index.

category.description: send (default): the track's sends; receive: its receives (the same objects, seen from the other end); hardware: its hardware outputs

index.description: 0-based index within the category

definition.name: remove_take_fx
definition.description: Remove one FX from a take's FX chain. Returns the take's FX chain afterwards.

fxIndex.description: 0-based take FX index

definition.name: remove_time
definition.description: Cut a time range out of the whole project and close the gap: items, markers, tempo markers, envelope points and automation items inside it are deleted, items and automation items crossing an edge lose the part inside it (an automation item spanning the whole cut stays, counted as automationItemsKept), regions shrink, and everything after moves earlier. The tempo in force at the end of the cut is kept. One undo point; returns what was deleted, trimmed and moved.

start.description: Start of the range in seconds

end.description: End of the range in seconds

definition.name: rename_fx
definition.description: Rename one FX instance as shown in the FX chain (REAPER 6.37+). An empty name restores the plugin's own name.

fxIndex.description: 0-based FX index in the track's chain

name.description: New display name, or "" to clear the rename

definition.name: render_project
definition.description: Render the project with its current render settings (set them with set_render_settings) and return the files written, each measured: duration, integrated LUFS, true peak and sample peak. Synchronous: REAPER is busy until the render finishes, so keep renders short. Refused when a target file already exists (REAPER would ask) unless overwrite is true, when bounds is time_selection with no time selection, and when the format or secondary format is an encoder outside wav/aiff/flac/mp3/ogg/opus (they can open a dialog).

overwrite.description: Delete existing target files before rendering

tracks.description: For source stems / master_and_stems / selected_via_master: the tracks to render (index, name or "{GUID}"), selected for this render only

items.description: Track: 0-based index (-1 = master), exact name, "{GUID}", or "master". A digit string means a track name first, then the index.

analyze.description: Measure each file written (default true; up to 16 files)

definition.name: render_versions
definition.description: Render alternate versions in one call (instrumental, a cappella, TV mix, clean): for each version the listed tracks are muted on top of the current mutes, the file pattern gets "-<name>" (or the version's own filePattern), and the project renders with the current settings. Every track, name and target is checked before the first render; mutes and the file pattern are restored afterwards, also when a render fails. Each file comes back measured like render_project.

name.description: Version name, used in the file name: letters, digits, space, - _ .

mute.description: Tracks muted in this version (index, name, "{GUID}")

items.description: Track: 0-based index (-1 = master), exact name, "{GUID}", or "master". A digit string means a track name first, then the index.

filePattern.description: File pattern for this version instead of "<pattern>-<name>"

versions.description: The versions to render, in order

overwrite.description: Replace existing target files

definition.name: report_plugin_build
definition.description: Call once at the end of a /make-plugin run, after the scratch track is deleted, also when the run stopped early. Records how it went in pseudonymous usage telemetry as fixed values and counts — never the plugin's name or what it does. The result shows exactly what was sent. Changes nothing in REAPER.

outcome.description: shipped: it compiled (the plugin changed the audio against bypass) and every check passed; compile_failed: the plugin loaded but left the audio unchanged or silent; checks_failed: it loaded but a check failed and was not fixed; abandoned: stopped early

example.description: The shipped example the plugin started from: mutate-verb, tape-sat, width-bass-mono, or none

rounds.description: write_jsfx → load → check rounds it took (default 1)

checksPassed.description: Verification checks that passed in the last round

checksFailed.description: Verification checks that failed in the last round

cleanedUp.description: The scratch track was deleted and nothing else changed

scratchTag.description: The <TAG> of your "[MCP] make-plugin <TAG>" track, so the server can time the run. Never sent.

definition.name: report_plugin_research
definition.description: Call once at the end of a plugin research run (the plugin-researcher's last step), after cleaning up the scratch track, also when the run stopped early. Records how the run went in pseudonymous usage telemetry as fixed values and counts — never the plugin's name. The result shows exactly what was sent. Changes nothing in REAPER.

outcome.description: new: a new record; refined: an existing record of yours, or an overlay on a built-in one; not_installed: no installed FX matched; load_failed: add_fx failed; no_lorekit: LoreKit not connected, nothing saved

category.description: The record's category (e.g. "compressor"); the first one if it has several

style.description: The record's style: transparent, character, vintage, modern or surgical

format.description: The format prefix of the FX name: VST, VST3, AU, CLAP, JS, LV2, DX, with an instrument's "i" (VST3i) as REAPER shows it

paramsTotal.description: How many parameters get_fx_parameters listed (sent only as a range); leave out when not known

paramsProbed.description: Parameters probed live in Step 4 (0 if not inspected)

openQuestions.description: Open questions in the report, preference included

cleanedUp.description: The scratch track was deleted and nothing else changed (false: report it first)

caller.description: Who dispatched the research: the prompt's "Dispatched by" line — learn-plugin, mixer or mastering (default other)

batchSize.description: Plugins researched in the same request: the prompt's "Batch" line (default 1)

scratchTag.description: The <TAG> of your "[MCP] plugin-research <TAG>" track, so the server can time the run. Never sent.

definition.name: run_action
definition.description: Run one REAPER action (like pressing its shortcut) in an undo block, and return its toggle state afterwards. Most actions work on the current selection: set it first with set_selected_tracks / set_selected_items. Actions that open a dialog (name ends in "...") are refused unless allowDialog is true, because a dialog blocks REAPER until a person closes it. Actions that quit REAPER, close/open/replace the project, or open, close or switch project tabs are always refused. A Custom: macro is refused if any step it runs would be. To combine actions with other edits in one undo step, use run_plan's run_action op.

action.description: Command id (40001), named id ("_SWS_…", "_aee8…" — stable across sessions; prefer it for custom actions and scripts), or the exact action name

section.description: Action section (default main). MIDI editor actions need an open MIDI editor.

allowDialog.description: Allow an action that opens a dialog — only when someone is at the screen to close it

definition.name: run_plan
definition.description: Execute a multi-step edit as ONE bridge call in ONE undo block, all-or-nothing. Use instead of many sequential tool calls. Ops run in order: add_track, set_track, add_fx, set_fx_params, add_send, graft_fxchain (copy a source FX chain onto a track; sends are not copied), select_tracks, copy_items / insert_time / remove_time (as the arrange tools), and run_action (any REAPER action — usually after select_tracks; same safety rules as run_action; only run_action ops may follow a run_action). Target tracks by index, exact name, "{GUID}", or a "$ref" that an earlier add_track/add_fx bound with `as`. Every target is resolved before anything is written: an unknown or ambiguous track rejects the whole plan, and a failure mid-apply reverts it. Use dryRun to preview resolution and conflicts. Pass an idempotencyKey so a retried call is not applied twice.

index.description: Insert position (default: end)

track.description: Track: 0-based index (-1 or "master" = master track), exact name, "{GUID}", or a "$ref" bound by an earlier add_track
Track: 0-based index (-1 or "master" = master track), exact name, "{GUID}", or a "$ref" bound by an earlier add_track

position.description: Chain position (default: end)

index.description: Parameter index

fx.description: FX: index on the track, unique name substring, or a "$ref" bound by an earlier add_fx

index.description: Parameter index

from.description: Track: 0-based index (-1 or "master" = master track), exact name, "{GUID}", or a "$ref" bound by an earlier add_track

to.description: Track: 0-based index (-1 or "master" = master track), exact name, "{GUID}", or a "$ref" bound by an earlier add_track

track.description: Target track; its items, envelopes and sends are kept

from.description: Source track in this project

fromChunk.description: Base64 track state chunk (e.g. a full-chunk snapshot track)

items.description: Track: 0-based index (-1 or "master" = master track), exact name, "{GUID}", or a "$ref" bound by an earlier add_track

mode.description: replace (default) or add to the selection

action.description: Command id (40001), named id ("_SWS_…", "_aee8…" — stable across sessions; prefer it for custom actions and scripts), or the exact action name

section.description: Action section (default main). MIDI editor actions need an open MIDI editor.

itemIndex.description: 0-based item index on the track (list_media_items order)

items.description: Items to copy, as the project is before the plan (no op that adds tracks or items may come first)

dryRun.description: Validate and resolve only; write nothing

idempotencyKey.description: Re-sending a key that was already applied returns the earlier result instead of applying again

snapshotBefore.description: Save a snapshot with this name before applying

definition.name: save_fx_chain
definition.description: Save a track's whole FX chain (with all settings) as an .RfxChain file in REAPER's FXChains folder, where REAPER's own "Add FX chain" finds it. The name may include subfolders ("Vocals/Lead") but never "..", an absolute path or a drive letter.

name.description: File name under FXChains/, without or with .RfxChain

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file of that name (default false: refuse)

definition.name: save_project
definition.description: Save the REAPER project. Without a path, saves it where it already lives. With path (an absolute .rpp file in an existing directory) it writes a copy there: the open project keeps its own path (savedAsCopy: true), so a never-saved project stays unsaved. Never opens a dialog: a never-saved project without path is refused; an existing different file is refused unless overwrite is true.

path.description: Absolute .rpp path to write a copy to

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at path

definition.name: save_track_template
definition.description: Save a track (name, FX chain, settings) as an .RTrackTemplate in REAPER's TrackTemplates folder. Items are left out unless includeItems is true; receives and folder state are never saved (they depend on the tracks around it). The name may include subfolders but never "..", an absolute path or a drive letter.

name.description: File name under TrackTemplates/, without or with .RTrackTemplate

includeItems.description: Also save the track's media items (default false)

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file of that name (default false: refuse)

definition.name: search_actions
definition.description: Search REAPER's action list (native, SWS/extensions, scripts, and the user's Custom: macros — ~6k actions) inside REAPER. Every query word must appear in the action name or named id (case-insensitive). Returns id, stable namedId, name, toggle state, keyboard shortcuts, and whether it opens a dialog or is always refused, plus the total match count.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. "track insert", "Custom:", "metronome"

section.description: Action section (default main). MIDI editor actions need an open MIDI editor.

definition.name: search_fx
definition.description: Search installed FX plugins by name (case-insensitive substring match)

query.description: Search term to match against FX plugin names

definition.name: send_midi_cc
definition.description: Send a MIDI CC (continuous controller) event in real-time to a track's MIDI output. Auto-inserts the MCP MIDI Emitter JSFX if not present. Common CC numbers: 1=modulation, 7=volume, 10=pan, 11=expression, 64=sustain, 74=filter cutoff.

definition.name: send_midi_note
definition.description: Send a MIDI note-on in real-time to a track's MIDI output. If durationMs is provided, a note-off is automatically scheduled after that many milliseconds. Auto-inserts the MCP MIDI Emitter JSFX if not present.

durationMs.description: Note duration in milliseconds (≥1) — if provided, schedules an automatic note-off

definition.name: send_midi_pc
definition.description: Send a MIDI program change in real-time, optionally preceded by bank select (CC0 MSB + CC32 LSB). Auto-inserts the MCP MIDI Emitter JSFX if not present.

bankMsb.description: Bank select MSB (CC0, 0-127) — omit if no bank select needed

bankLsb.description: Bank select LSB (CC32, 0-127) — omit if no bank select needed

definition.name: separate_stems
definition.description: Split a track (rendered post-FX, -1 = master) or an audio file into stems with Demucs: htdemucs gives drums, bass, other, vocals; htdemucs_6s adds guitar and piano. Writes one 32-bit float WAV per stem to outDir (default: a new folder under the project's Stems folder) and returns each stem's path, LUFS and peak. With insertTracks, adds them as tracks under a new folder in one undo point, lined up with the source (a track: after it, at startTime; a file: at filePosition + startTime); the folder starts muted, since the stems sum back to the source. Slow: about real time on a CPU, several times faster on Apple silicon or CUDA (max 600 s per call). Needs `reaper-mcp setup-sidecar --with-separation` (which downloads htdemucs; the first htdemucs_6s call downloads its ~80 MB weights).

trackIndex.description: Track to analyze, rendered post-FX (-1 = master: the whole mix). Give this or path

path.description: Absolute path of an audio file (WAV/FLAC/AIFF/MP3/OGG) instead of a track, e.g. a reference song

startTime.description: Start in seconds (default 0)

endTime.description: End in seconds (track default: startTime + 60; file default: its end)

model.description: htdemucs (4 stems, default) or htdemucs_6s (adds guitar and piano)

stems.description: Write only these stems (default: all the model gives)

outDir.description: Absolute folder for the stem WAVs (created if missing)

insertTracks.description: Insert the stems as tracks under a new folder track (muted)

filePosition.description: With path and insertTracks: project time where the file starts (default 0)

definition.name: set_active_take
definition.description: Make one take of a media item the active (playing) take. Returns the item's takes afterwards.

definition.name: set_automation_item
definition.description: Move, resize or change an automation item: position, length, start offset, play rate, baseline, amplitude, loop, pool name. Points are edited with edit_envelope_points and automationItemIndex.

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track (from get_track_envelopes)

position.description: Item start in seconds

startOffset.description: Seconds into the pool's points where this instance starts

loop.description: Loop the pool's points when the item is longer than them

name.description: Pool name, shared by every instance (e.g. "Vox Chorus")

definition.name: set_automation_mode
definition.description: Set the automation mode of tracks (trim/read, read, touch, write, latch, latch_preview) and/or REAPER's global automation override ("none" clears it, "bypass" turns all automation off). Returns each track's mode before and after. Write/latch/touch record fader moves while playing.

items.description: Track: 0-based index (-1 = master), exact name, "{GUID}", or "master". A digit string means a track name first, then the index.

definition.name: set_cursor_position
definition.description: Move the edit cursor to a specific position in seconds from project start

position.description: Position in seconds from project start

definition.name: set_envelope_properties
definition.description: Set properties (active, visible, armed) on a track envelope. Requires SWS extension for full support.

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track (from get_track_envelopes)

visible.description: Set envelope visible/hidden in arrange view

armed.description: Set envelope armed for writing automation

definition.name: set_fx_enabled
definition.description: Enable or disable (bypass) an FX plugin on a track

fxIndex.description: Zero-based FX index in the chain

definition.name: set_fx_offline
definition.description: Set an FX plugin online or offline. Offline FX uses no CPU but preserves settings.

fxIndex.description: Zero-based FX index in the chain

definition.name: set_fx_param_modulation
definition.description: Modulate an FX parameter (REAPER 6.37+): an LFO, an audio control signal (the parameter follows a channel's level, e.g. a sidechain on 3/4), and/or a link to another FX parameter on the same track. Only the fields given change; enabled:false turns all modulation of the parameter off. One undo point; the state before is returned.

fxIndex.description: 0-based FX index in the track's chain

enabled.description: false turns off all modulation of this parameter

baseline.description: 0..1, the value the modulation moves around

speed.description: Hz, or quarter notes per cycle with tempoSync

direction.description: -1 moves the value down from the baseline, 0 around it, 1 up (default)

audio.description: Audio control signal: the parameter follows a channel's level

minDb.description: Level that maps to no modulation

maxDb.description: Level that maps to full modulation

channel.description: Track channel to follow, 1-based (3 = a sidechain on 3/4)

direction.description: -1 moves the value down from the baseline, 0 around it, 1 up (default)

link.description: Follow another FX parameter on this track

fxIndex.description: Source FX; required unless enabled is false

paramIndex.description: Source parameter; required unless enabled is false

definition.name: set_fx_parameter
definition.description: Set a specific FX parameter value (normalized 0.0–1.0 for most plugins; use the parameter maxValue from get_fx_parameters when it is above 1)

fxIndex.description: Zero-based FX index in the chain

definition.name: set_fx_pins
definition.description: Connect FX pins to track channels (1-based, up to 64). Give a channel list per pin ([[1],[2],[3],[4]]) or only the pins to change ([{pin: 2, channels: [3]}, {pin: 3, channels: [4]}] routes a sidechain on 3/4). The track is widened to the highest channel used; trackChannels sets it explicitly. All validated before any write; one undo point.

fxIndex.description: 0-based FX index in the track's chain

trackChannels.description: Even channel count for the track

definition.name: set_fx_preset
definition.description: Apply a named preset to an FX plugin on a track

fxIndex.description: Zero-based FX index in the chain

definition.name: set_item_color
definition.description: Set a media item's color, or "none" to go back to the track's default. Returns the color and fades REAPER reads back.

definition.name: set_item_fades
definition.description: Set a media item's fade-in/out lengths, shapes and curves; only the fields given change. Shapes: 0 linear, 1 fast start, 2 fast end, 3 fast start (steep), 4 fast end (steep), 5 slow start/end, 6 slow start/end (steep). Returns the color and fades REAPER reads back.

definition.name: set_media_item_properties
definition.description: Set media item properties: position (seconds), length (seconds), volume (dB), mute, fade in/out lengths, play rate
